proof_body:
by
  intro G _ N _
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [commutator_def, Subgroup.commutator_le]
    intro a _ b _
    rw [← QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff, commutatorElement_def]
    simp only [QuotientGroup.mk_mul, QuotientGroup.mk_inv]
    rw [h (a : G ⧸ N) (b : G ⧸ N)]
    group
  · intro h a b
    induction a using QuotientGroup.induction_on with
    | H a =>
      induction b using QuotientGroup.induction_on with
      | H b =>
        have hm : a * b * a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ ∈ N := by
          apply h
          rw [commutator_def]
          exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top a) (Subgroup.mem_top b)
        have hq := (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr hm
        simp only [QuotientGroup.mk_mul, QuotientGroup.mk_inv] at hq
        calc (a : G ⧸ N) * b = (a : G ⧸ N) * b * (a : G ⧸ N)⁻¹ * (b : G ⧸ N)⁻¹ * (b * a) := by group
          _ = b * a := by rw [hq, one_mul]
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal], (∀ a b : G ⧸ N, a * b = b * a) ↔ commutator G ≤ N
